fichas.title: Backflow prevention devices
fichas.summary: Application areas and approved backflow prevention device types are tabulated for faeces-free water and precipitation water, wastewater containing faeces, and rainwater utilisation facilities. The page also illustrates a wastewater lifting-pump arrangement and describes protection against sewer back-up.

fichas.title: Roof drainage with pressurised flow
fichas.summary: Pressurised roof drainage requires hydraulic certification for each project. Backing-up at the outlet is not considered roof flooding when outlet requirements are met. Roofs subject to regular flooding require waterproofing and structural design to the flooding level. When discharging into unpressurised pipework, reduce flow velocity to limit kinetic energy.
uses: Drain roof surfaces using pressurised-flow drainage

dimensions.label: Maximum flow velocity after reduction
dimensions.context: Flow velocity is to be reduced to less than this value when pressurised drainage feeds into an unpressurised pipework system.

fichas.title: Sewer back-up and special wastewater
fichas.summary: Discharge locations below the sewer back-up level require protection by an automatic wastewater lifting pump with a back-up loop or a backflow prevention device. Double lifting systems are specified where wastewater flow must not be interrupted. The text also calls for flooding and overloading certification in relevant cases and treatment or separation of commercial and industrial wastewater before discharge to a public foul sewer.
spaces: Discharge locations below sewer back-up level
uses: Prevent sewer back-up at low-level discharge points
